research_scope: Five early/base-game PQ skills selected after live repository duplicate checks. PQ acquisition identity is independently corroborated; unsupported reward probabilities remain unresolved.

records.name: Meteor Blow
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 09 — The Saiyan King Is...Who?
records.skill_description: A two-hit Strike Super that launches the opponent and follows with a finishing kick.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 skill reference identifies Meteor Blow as a Strike Super using 100 Ki and obtainable from PQ09. The same reference describes the launching upkick followed by a teleporting finishing blow. Exact reward-slot/drop conditions are unresolved.
records.combo_notes: The first kick can be used as a combo confirm; the second hit provides the follow-up knockback.

records.name: Earth Splitting Galick Gun
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 11 — Burst Open and Mix!
records.skill_description: A fast, multi-hit purple Galick Gun beam.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 skill reference identifies Earth Splitting Galick Gun as a Ki Blast Super using 200 Ki and obtainable from PQ11, with up to 23 hits. A newer independently maintained PQ database reports the skill in an Ultimate Finish reward roll; that condition is retained as source-specific evidence rather than converted to an unconditional canonical boolean.

records.name: Meteor Crash
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 12 — In the Name of Frieza!
records.skill_description: A multi-hit Strike Super that continues with additional attacks while Ki is available.
records.mechanics_notes: The independent PQ reward transcription places Meteor Crash in PQ12. Exact current hit scaling, total Ki consumption, and reward-slot semantics are left unresolved pending a stronger skill-specific technical reference.

records.name: Fighting Pose C
records.skill_description: A Power Up pose that temporarily prevents abnormal status effects.
records.mechanics_notes: PQ13 reward transcriptions identify Fighting Pose C. Current skill-reference material documents a 0-Ki Power Up Super with a 20-second duration and abnormal-status prevention. Exact reward-slot semantics remain unresolved.

records.name: Kaioken Kamehameha
records.mechanics_notes: The independent PQ reward transcription and current skill guide place Kaioken Kamehameha in PQ14. The documented skill cost is 200 Ki. Exact reward-slot semantics and any additional Kaioken-state interactions are left unresolved here.
